PR: Update metrics to reflect function and controller scope [closed; labels release/breaking-behavior-change]
### Description of your changes

Updated Prometheus metrics subsystem and documentation strings in `internal/xfn/` and `internal/engine/` to reflect that these metrics now apply to both composition functions and operation functions, not just composition-specific functionality.

- Changed subsystem from "composition" to "function" in xfn metrics
- Updated documentation strings to remove composition-specific language
- Updated engine metrics to remove "XR" prefix since they now track bot…

With the introduction of the Operations framework, these metrics are no longer composition-specific and should accurately reflect their broader scope.

Added the breaking behavior change because anyone using these metrics will need to update to the new names.
